entries.name: GUSTO_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: Client ID of the KaratOS app in Gusto's developer portal, used with the client secret to refresh Gusto access tokens.
howToGet: On dev.gusto.com, open the KaratOS application and its OAuth settings.
Copy the Client ID straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: GUSTO_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: Client secret of the Gusto app. It refreshes access tokens and is the key the instance encrypts its stored refresh token with, so rotating it means reconnecting Gusto.
howToGet: On the application's page in the Gusto developer portal, copy the secret straight into the host's secret store.
After rotating it, reconnect the company and set a new GUSTO_REFRESH_TOKEN, because the stored token can no longer be decrypted.

entries.name: GUSTO_REDIRECT_URI
entries.description: The redirect URI registered for the Gusto app. Gusto asks for it on every token refresh. Not a secret.
howToGet: Copy the redirect URI exactly as it is registered on the application's page in the Gusto developer portal.

entries.name: GUSTO_COMPANY_UUID
entries.description: The company's UUID in Gusto. Not a secret, but it names the client's payroll. The connector stops if the token belongs to another company.
howToGet: After the company is connected, call GET /v1/token_info with the access token and copy resource.uuid (resource.type is Company).

entries.name: GUSTO_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting the company. Gusto replaces it on every refresh, so after the first sync the instance keeps the newest one encrypted in its database and this value only seeds it. Replacing it here (after reconnecting) takes over from the stored one.
howToGet: Give the KaratOS app only the payrolls:read scope in the Gusto developer portal, then have a company admin connect the company.
The connector rejects a connection holding any scope beyond reading, so don't add others.
Copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: GUSTO_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Which Gusto host to read: production (api.gusto.com) or demo (api.gusto-demo.com). production when empty.
howToGet: Leave empty for a live company. Set demo only for a company in Gusto's demo environment.

entries.name: GUSTO_WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
entries.description: The verification_token of the Gusto webhook subscription, which signs each delivery (X-Gusto-Signature). Only needed once webhooks are turned on; the scheduled sync works without it.
howToGet: When the webhook subscription is created, Gusto sends the verification_token to its URL. Copy it straight into the host's secret store.
